heading: Check your application or petition before you submit
headings_all: Check your application or petition before you submit
page_text_first_1500: Jump to content An official website of the United States government Here's how you know My Account Resources Sign Out Skip to main content I-131, Application for Travel Documents, Parole Documents Getting Started Client Information Upload PDF Evidence Review & Submit Review your Application Check your application or petition before you submit We will review your application or petition to check for accuracy and completeness before you submit it. We encourage you to provide as many responses as you can throughout the application or petition to ensure that it is complete, true, and accurate. You can return to this page to review your application or petition as many times as you want before you submit it. Alerts and warnings You have one or more alerts and warnings based on the information you provided in your application or petition. Form I-131 Your Form I-131 is missing Edit my responses Form G-28 Your Form G-28 is missing Edit my responses Your fee Your form filing fee is: $0.00 Refund Policy: USCIS does not refund fees, regardless of any action we take on your application, petition or request, or how long USCIS takes to reach a decision. _note: Page title 'USCIS | Review Your Submission'. Same terminal-guard trap as the I-485/I-765/N-400: next-btn is DISABLED while items are missing, so a successful fill/upload run ENABLES it - mark this page kind:'review' and make the terminal guard cover /review on this host path. Only TWO alerts ('Your Form I-131 is missing', 'Your Form G-28 is missing'), each with an 'Edit my responses' button; the five evidence slots raise NO review alert, they only warn in-page at Next time. Fee line read 'Your form filing fee is: $0.00' on this incomplete draft - unverified, not the real I-131 fee. NOT advanced past this page: no submit, no payment, no signature.
